The Index decision of 2026-11-26 at afb962e68831a16accb80c70159b1e2f1fbb4dbc, SHA-256 f52fe2ec63ac3a542a4d19218cbec5121232c26294461be2ea551b53cd3b0aba, binds 53e9926f8a8841c28fb9d69e14e86ea5, Academic Free License v3.0, afl-3-0, sha256:ab790354e9403bb7cf29e8ff3fdbff314dcc8ca67d9d37f1fa3a45f2dbc052b6, license and active in bytes [1627,1817).

challenge.method: Compared the OSI witnesses for AFL 3.0 and OSL 3.0, including their notices and section 1(c). Checked whether the historical value assigned to AFL 2.1 also applied to AFL 3.0.
challenge.results: AFL permits distribution under a license of the distributor’s choice subject to its stated constraints. OSL requires distributed copies to carry the OSL. Their common structure and copyright attribution do not merge them. The decision assigns historical to a different AFL 2.1 entity and active to AFL 3.0.

limitations: Active means the Index maintains this reference for lookup after selection. Publisher currency, SPDX deprecation and release authorization are separate determinations.

The grant depends on a licensor placing the specified notice adjacent to a work’s copyright notice. This review establishes documentary identity only. Work-specific use, redistribution and installation require separate evidence.
reasoning: OSI’s CMS record 366 identifies the Academic Free License version 3.0 in the licensing notice itself. Its grant meets the Index definition of a license. The separately pinned Index decision assigns active to the same entity, edition and publisher revision.
